page.overview:
What is Paul Frank?

Paul Frank is a licensed theme that features sets and products based on the popular [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_Frank_Industries Paul Frank industries] line of designer clothes. Only one Paul Frank set was a LEGO System set, the others mostly counting as LEGO Wear.

Only one minifigure was introduced in this theme, Julius the Monkey.
